name: SRM Contractors Ltd
title: SRM Contractors Ltd - 544158 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue ₹1,026 cr (+94%) with 8.1% EBITDA margin, but management guides FY27 margins of 16–18% and ~₹250 cr capex funded partly by project debt, with a messy call on order book definitions.

capex.quote: we are expecting a capex of around INR250 crores

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 45–55%
triggers.quote: We expect revenue growth of approximately 45% to 55% with EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 16% to 18%

triggers.label: Unbilled revenue ~₹130 cr
triggers.quote: currently, the unbilled revenue is around – we are ranging in around INR130 crores

triggers.label: FY27 capex ~₹250 cr, debt-funded
triggers.quote: we are expecting a capex of around INR250 crores

guidance.quote: We expect revenue growth of approximately 45% to 55%
EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 16% to 18%
Our targeted order inflow of financial ‘27 stands of approximately INR2,000 crore
this year our consolidated turnover should be between INR1,500 crores to INR1,750 crore

prior_guidance_check.quote: Revenue grew 94% year-on-year to INR1,026 crore

red_flags.label: Trade payables jump ₹68 cr to ~₹145 cr; FY26 auditor change and expense reclassification
red_flags.quote: we have seen a change in auditor in the current financial year

red_flags.label: Q4 gross margin falls to ~21% from 53–54% in Q2/Q3; unbilled revenue ~₹130 cr
red_flags.quote: the increase in COGS is just because of the fact that we – and we have an inventory of around INR47 crores as well

red_flags.label: Order book definition inconsistent (₹1,800 cr vs ₹3,000 cr; standalone vs consolidated)
Debt-to-equity quoted as '0.3% to 0.2%'; debt rise from equipment financing
red_flags.quote: Debt-to-equity ratio is -- will remain something like from 0.3% to 0.2% only.

red_flags.label: Other financial assets ₹157 cr incl. ₹82 cr security deposits; ₹37 cr receivables >1 year moved to non-current

evasions.quote: We don't have any monthly run rate.
